notes.title: Rewind or Die v1.2.0 Update
notes.notes:
[b]Rewind or Die 1.2 Patch Notes[/b]

[b]Updated AI for slaw in sewers[/b]
Added a chase start grace period - Slaw no longer chases immediately after seeing player for a fraction of a second giving you a little time to avoid a chase
Lowered the range Slaw can see in the sewers to make the chase more forgiving
Slaw no longer knows where you are at all times
Extra props to aid in breaking line of sight in longer sections

[b]Quality of Life Improvements[/b]
Clearer puzzle progression
Clearer item placements / item requirements

[b]Glitches[/b]
Removed the duplicate backpack glitch

[b]Additional[/b]
Minor graphical fixes
Minor bug fixes
Fixed typos
